title: Three Seasons and One Short Whistle
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：teamwork　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 teamwork 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the coach ① learnt the teamwork that no player in the field would have recorded, and he said the learning was the whole of the season. The ② teamwork, meaning the cooperation itself and not the whistle, ran three seasons and stayed unrecorded in the book; teamwork, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of teamwork in that field had the same short whistle beside it, and the ④ teamwork at the far stand, meaning the goal they kept for the children to cheer and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Teamwork, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the coach said the recording is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the teamwork was the whole of the matter, meaning the trust and not the cooperation. The ⑥ teamwork, meaning the trust and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; teamwork, he said, is either something you learn or the only word that means both cooperation and a trust. He said the trust is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ teamwork had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short whistle. The ⑧ teamwork of the whole thing, the coach wrote in April, was one field and three seasons of recording; teamwork, he said, is either the goal at the far stand or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ teamwork I remember is the teamwork recorded in the record, which closed in 1961 and is still recorded as the quietest in the field. ⑩ Teamwork, my mother said in 1963, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all teamwork, she said, is a trust that has agreed to look like cooperation. She said the trust was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 团队合作（指球场里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 团队合作（指那分团队合作本身，与小小的哨子相对）
C. 固定搭配：learn the teamwork 学会这一分团队合作
D. n. 团队合作（指留给孩子们喊的那一个）
E. n. 团队合作之事（抽象总称，指一处球场的团队合作之事）
F. n. 团队合作（指赛事记录里写到、被记载的那一分）
G. n. 团队合作、信任（指一件事里人人都练却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 信任（抽象总称，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: learnt the teamwork that no player in the field would have recorded
The teamwork, meaning the cooperation itself and not the whistle
Every sort of teamwork in that field
the teamwork at the far stand
the teamwork was the whole of the matter
the teamwork had become a line in a record
The teamwork of the whole thing

answers.why: learn the teamwork 意为“学会这一分团队合作”，1954 年那位教练把球场里没有一位队员肯记载的一分团队合作做了一遍。
teamwork 意为“团队合作”，指那分团队合作本身而不是小小的哨子，它经过了三个赛季而在簿子上没有被记载。
teamwork 意为“团队合作”，指球场里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一只小小的哨子。
teamwork 意为“团队合作”，指最远那面看台的留给孩子们喊的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
teamwork 意为“团队合作、信任”，指一件事里人人都练却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这分信任就是那件事的全部。
teamwork 意为“信任”，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西而不是那分团队合作，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
teamwork 意为“团队合作”，指赛事记录里写到、被记载的那一分，到 1959 年这一分成了赛事记录里的一行。
teamwork 意为“团队合作之事”，教练四月写道，整件事的团队合作之事是一处球场和三个赛季的记载。
teamwork 意为“团队合作”，我记得的是赛事记录里记载过的那一分，1961 年打完了，至今仍被说成球场里最安静的一分。
teamwork 为抽象总称，母亲 1963 年说，团队合作是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的团队合作。
